app.name: Timed Memories
app.summary: Shows a photo full-screen with its age as a caption: the months and days from a reference date to the day it was taken.
app.reference_date_hint: The date the age is counted from, as year-month-day, e.g. 2025-06-15. A birthday works well: the caption then reads how old the subject is in the photo.
app.show_button_hint: A round button in the corner that triggers an action without waking the screen.
app.button_action_hint: A script or automation to run, typed as script.<name> or automation.<name>, or a service for this camera as domain.action, e.g. image.reload. The button stays out while it is empty.
app.button_icon_hint: A Material Design Icons name for the button, such as skip-next, play, pause, shuffle-variant or heart. While it is empty or names an icon the screen cannot draw, a default (skip-next) stands in.
